texts.Features:WeChatWorkEnableDesc: Enable to enable the application to have WeCom capabilities.
texts.Features:MessageEnableDesc: Enable so that the app will have the ability to push messages to the app via WeCom.
texts.Features:Message.LimitDesc: Set to limit the WeCom application message push limit.
texts.Features:Message.LimitIntervalDesc: Set the limit period of WeCom messages (time scale: days). Each application cannot exceed the limit number of accounts *200 people/day.
texts.Features:AppChatMessage: Enterprise WeChat group chat message push
texts.Features:AppChatMessageEnable: Enable enterprise WeChat group chat message push
texts.Features:AppChatMessageEnableDesc: Enable so that the app will have the ability to push group chat messages through WeChat Enterprise.
texts.Features:AppChatMessage.Limit: Enterprise WeChat group chat message push limit
texts.Features:AppChatMessage.LimitDesc: Set to limit the upper limit of enterprise WeChat group chat message push.
texts.Features:AppChatMessage.LimitInterval: Enterprise WeChat group chat message limit period
texts.Features:AppChatMessage.LimitIntervalDes: Set the enterprise WeChat group chat message limit period (time scale: minutes). Group messages sent by all applications of each enterprise cannot exceed 20,000 people/minute, and cannot exceed 300,000 people/hour.
texts.Features:WebhookMessageEnable: Enable enterprise WeChat Webhook message push
texts.Features:WebhookMessageEnableDesc: Enable so that the application will have the ability to push Webhook messages through Enterprise WeChat
texts.Features:WebhookMessage.Limit: Enterprise WeChat Webhook message push limit
texts.Features:WebhookMessage.LimitDesc: Set to limit the upper limit of enterprise WeChat Webhook message push
texts.Features:WebhookMessage.LimitInterval: Enterprise WeChat Webhook message limit period
texts.Features:WebhookMessage.LimitIntervalDes: Set the enterprise WeChat Webhook message limit period (time scale: minutes). The messages sent by each message push cannot exceed 20 messages/minute.
texts.Description:WeChatWork.Connection.CorpId: Each enterprise has a unique corpid. To obtain this information, you can view the "Corporate ID" under "My Enterprise" - "Enterprise Information" in the management background (administrator rights are required)
texts.Description:WeChatWork.Connection.AgentI: Each application has a unique agentid. In the management background -> "Application Management" -> "Applications", click on an application to see the agentid
texts.Description:WeChatWork.Connection.Secret: Secret is the "key" used in enterprise applications to ensure data security. Each application has an independent access key. In order to ensure data security, the secret must not be leaked. In the management background -> "Application Management" -> "Application" -> "Self-Build", click on an application to see it.
texts.Description:WeChatWork.EnabledQuickLogin: Users can log in directly by scanning the code obtained when they are not registered.
